It's a single Prisma client. Before choosing the path and the timeout, I'll ask platform-agent what the load balancer expects.

args.message: shopfront is getting a health check endpoint that also pings the database. What path does the load balancer probe, and with what timeout?

history.content: platform-agent: It probes GET /api/health every 10 seconds with a 2 second timeout, and takes an instance out of rotation after 3 failures in a row. It only looks at the status code: any 200 is healthy, and the body is ignored.
So the database check has to finish well inside 2 seconds. I'll give it 1 second and answer 503 when it doesn't make it.
